turns.result:
The yen receipt test now passes, and all 3 tests pass. I only changed `src/payments/receipt.js`.

The real bug is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, so ¥500 came out as "¥5.00". That file is owned by another team, so I left it alone. Instead, `receipt.js` now formats yen (JPY) itself, since yen has no minor unit, and still uses `formatMoney` for every other currency.

Invoices use the same `formatMoney`, so they probably show yen wrong too. The better long-term fix is to make `formatMoney` handle zero-decimal currencies. You may want to pass that to the owners of `src/utils/`, after which the special case in `receipt.js` can go.
